nary_nodes.label: Census survey on AI use
evidence: The findings are based on a weekly national Census Bureau survey of individuals and households on topics including employment, food and nutrition, and transportation.

nary_nodes.label: Workers report AI use
evidence: About 55% of workers say they use AI on the job, with about one-third of those reporting it cuts the time they need to complete a given assignment by one to two hours, according to new data from the U.S. Census Bureau.

nary_nodes.label: AI saves less than an hour
evidence: One-quarter of employees who reported using AI at work say the tools shaved less than an hour off the time it would otherwise have taken them to complete a task, according to the Census data.

nary_nodes.label: AI saves three hours
evidence: A smaller share, at 15%, of workers saw even greater efficiency gains, saying that AI cut their workloads by three hours per task.
